symptom: mendixlabs/mxcli#1461: DESCRIBE printed a Studio Pro layout-grid row with a visibility condition as a bare `row { … }`, and `row (Visible: …)` passed check and exec and was not written; describe -> exec (create or modify / replace) of such a page silently made every conditional row always visible, mx check clean. Visible: on a layout-grid column was dropped too, without a warning.
cause: Same shape as the tab page (#1465): a row is built by buildLayoutGridV3/buildLayoutGridRowV3, not buildWidgetV3, so the visibility tail never ran; sdk/pages.LayoutGridRow had no field; layoutGridRowToGen never set it, so the registered NullFields default wrote null over the stored condition on every rewrite; parseLayoutGridRows never read it. A column has no slot at all: gen Forms$LayoutGridColumn has no ConditionalVisibilitySettings and 0 of 732 Studio Pro columns (TestApp + PedApp) carry the key, while 483 of 483 rows do.
file: sdk/pages/pages_widgets_container.go (LayoutGridRow.ConditionalVisibility); mdl/executor/cmd_pages_builder_v3_layout.go (childVisibility, shared with buildTabPageV3; top-level row leaves it to the wrapping container); mdl/backend/modelsdk/widget_write.go (layoutGridRowToGen); mdl/executor/cmd_pages_describe_parse.go (parseLayoutGridRows -> extractConditionalSettings); mdl/executor/validate_layoutgrid_column_visible.go (MDL-WIDGET07 warning for a column inside a row)
insight: Scan the fixtures' stored BSON for the key per $Type before deciding row vs column: one Go walk over mprcontents settled it (rows 483/483 have the key, columns 0/732) where the issue asked for both. TestApp's only conditional row (WorkflowCommons.Snip_DashboardContext_Timeline) sits inside a pluggable timeline slot that is passed through, so the TestApp round trip never saw the loss and ALTER (raw mutator) preserves it too — the destruction is in the rebuild path only; reproduce it by writing a conditional row with the fixed binary and re-running describe -> exec with the old one (Replaced, conditions gone) vs the new one (Unchanged). A top-level `row` is a container around a one-row grid; buildWidgetV3 already puts Visible: on the container, so the row must not carry it a second time. Note MDL-WIDGET43 (datagrid column $currentObject) also fires on a layout-grid `column`, labelled datagrid column.
